newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end firmer in light volume.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end firmer in light volume.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed a dull session firmer, with the bulk of buying by locals emerging on the close, traders said.
They also noted some trade scale-up selling.
Prices continued to drift within a range seen between 115.00 and 110.00 basis the November contract. Volume was estimated at only 1,200 lots.
The November contract settled up 1.45 at 112.10, having ranged from 112.40 to 111.00. The back months settled 1.35 to 1.00 firmer.
Paine Webber analyst Bernard Savaiko noted that "(prices are) ensconsed in a downtrend channel on the weekly charts."

He pegged support in November between the recent low of 110.00, and then at 109.25. "If it gets that low there could be a breakdown out of a bear flag that could take us back down to 106.00," Savaiko said.
Friday is the last trading day for November FCOJ options.
Market sources said players are likey to trade cautiously ahead of the U.S. Department of Agriculture's estimate for the 1996/97 Florida crop, released October 11.
